prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay home.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
If it rained tomorrow, we will stay home.
answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.

wrong.If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay h: if 子句表示未來的條件時，要用現在式 rains，不能在 if 後面用 will。
wrong.If it rained tomorrow, we will stay home: rained 是過去式，但 tomorrow 是未來，而且主要子句用 will，if 子句應該用現在式。

why: 表示未來可能發生的事，if 子句用現在式，主要子句用 will。
tip: if 子句用現在式代替未來，主句才用 will。
say: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: If you _____ hard, you will pass the English exam.
options: study
will study
studied
are study

wrong.will study: if 子句裡不用 will，未來的條件用現在式 study。
wrong.studied: studied 是過去式，這裡說的是將來可能的情況，要用現在式。
wrong.are study: are 後面不能直接接原形動詞 study，文法不正確。

why: If + 現在式，主要子句 + will + 原形動詞，是未來條件句的基本結構。
tip: If 後面用現在式，後面主句用 will。
say: If you study hard, you will pass the English exam.

prompt: 朋友說他不想爬山，你想說：「如果你不想去，我們就待在家。」哪一句最適合？
options: If you don't want to go, we will stay home.
If you won't want to go, we stay home.
Unless you don't want to go, we will stay home.
answer: If you don't want to go, we will stay home.

if 子句不用 will，而且主句應用 will stay 表示將要做的事。
wrong.Unless you don't want to go, we will sta: unless 本身已經有『除非不』的意思，再加 don't 會變成雙重否定，意思反而變成『除非你不想去，否則我們待在家』。

why: 用 if 表示條件，if 子句用現在式否定，主句用 will。
tip: if not 可以改用 unless，但 unless 後面不用 not。
say: If you don't want to go, we will stay home.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: _____ you hurry, you will miss the last bus.
options: Unless
If
Although
Because

wrong.If: If you hurry 是『如果你趕快』，卻接『會錯過末班車』，前後邏輯矛盾。
wrong.Although: Although 表示轉折（雖然），這裡不是轉折而是條件。
wrong.Because: Because 表示原因，但這句話是在說條件，不是原因。

why: Unless you hurry 等於 If you don't hurry，意思是『除非你趕快，否則會錯過』，和後面的 miss 邏輯一致。
tip: unless 等於 if ... not，後面不再加 not。
say: Unless you hurry, you will miss the last bus.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Unless you don't leave now, you will be late.
Unless you leave now, you will be late.
Unless you will leave now, you will be late.
answer: Unless you leave now, you will be late.

wrong.Unless you don't leave now, you will be: unless 已經帶有否定意思，不能再加 don't，否則變成雙重否定。
wrong.Unless you will leave now, you will be l: unless 子句和 if 子句一樣，表示未來時要用現在式，不用 will。

why: Unless you leave now 等於 If you don't leave now，意思是『除非你現在離開』。
tip: Unless = If ... not，不要重複否定。
say: Unless you leave now, you will be late.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The ground is wet _____ it rained last night.
options: because
so
but
unless

wrong.so: so 後面接的是結果，但 it rained last night 是原因，不是結果。
wrong.but: but 表示轉折，這裡下雨和地面濕是因果關係，不是對立。
wrong.unless: unless 表示『除非』，不是說明原因。

why: 地面濕是結果，昨晚下雨是原因，用 because 引導原因。
tip: because 後面接原因，so 後面接結果。
say: The ground is wet because it rained last night.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: _____ Mia was very tired, she finished her homework.
options: Although
Because
If
So

wrong.Because: 累是原因，但她還是寫完作業，是出乎意料的轉折，不是因果關係。
wrong.If: If 是假設條件，但 Mia was tired 是已經發生的事實。
wrong.So: So 連接結果，不能放在句首開頭引導這個子句。

why: 累了卻還是完成，前後意思相反，用 Although（雖然）表示讓步。
tip: although 後面接完整句子，不可再加 but。
say: Although Mia was very tired, she finished her homework.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Although it was cold, but we went swimming.
Although it was cold, we went swimming.
Because it was cold, but we went swimming.
answer: Although it was cold, we went swimming.

wrong.Although it was cold, but we went swimmi: although 和 but 不能同時使用，中文可以說『雖然……但是』，英文只能擇一。
wrong.Because it was cold, but we went swimmin: because 表示原因，天氣冷不會是去游泳的原因，而且也不能和 but 連用。

why: although 已經表示轉折，不需要再加 but。
tip: although 和 but 擇一，英文不能同時出現。
say: Although it was cold, we went swimming.

prompt: 你想說「如果我有時間，我會幫你。」哪一句最自然？
options: If I have time, I will help you.
If I will have time, I help you.
If I had time, I will help you.
answer: If I have time, I will help you.

if 子句裡不用 will，主句也應該用 will help 表示將來要做的事。
had 是過去式，if 子句的時態和主句 will 不搭配，會讓意思混亂。

why: 表示有可能發生的條件，if 用現在式，主句用 will。
tip: 可能發生的事：If + 現在式，will + 原形。
say: If I have time, I will help you.

prompt: 『Unless it stops raining, we can't play baseball.』的意思是？
options: 除非雨停，否則我們不能打棒球
只要下雨，我們就打棒球
雨停了，所以我們不能打棒球
因為下雨，所以我們打棒球
answer: 除非雨停，否則我們不能打棒球

wrong.只要下雨，我們就打棒球: 句子說的是不能打棒球，而且 unless 是『除非』，不是『只要』。
wrong.雨停了，所以我們不能打棒球: it stops 是條件，不是已經發生的事實，而且因果關係也不對。
wrong.因為下雨，所以我們打棒球: 主句是 can't，表示不能打，意思完全相反。

why: Unless 相當於 if ... not，意思是『如果雨沒有停，我們就不能打棒球』。
tip: unless 就是『除非』，等於 if 加 not。
say: Unless it stops raining, we can't play baseball.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: If I _____ you, I would study harder for the test.
options: were
am
will be
was being

wrong.am: 這是和現實相反的假設，不是事實，不能用 am。
wrong.will be: if 子句不用 will，而且這裡是假設語氣，用 were。
wrong.was being: was being 是進行式，不是假設語氣的標準用法。

why: If I were you 是假設語氣，說的是不可能成真的事，be 動詞一律用 were。
tip: If I were you 是給建議的常用句型。
say: If I were you, I would study harder for the test.

prompt: 朋友問你該不該把秘密告訴弟弟，你想給建議：「如果我是你，我會告訴他。」哪一句最合適？
options: If I were you, I would tell him.
If I am you, I will tell him.
If I was you, I tell him.
answer: If I were you, I would tell him.

我不可能真的是你，這是假設，不是事實，所以不能用 am 和 will。
主句缺少助動詞 would，而且假設語氣的 be 動詞用 were。

why: 與現實不符的假設，用 If I were ..., I would ...。
tip: 給建議：If I were you, I would ...。
say: If I were you, I would tell him.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I can't go out because it rain heavily.
I can't go out because it is raining heavily.
I can't go out because of it is raining heavily.
answer: I can't go out because it is raining heavily.

it 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，或用 is raining 表示正在下雨。
wrong.I can't go out because of it is raining: because of 後面接名詞，不接完整句子；接句子要用 because。

why: because 後面接完整句子；because of 後面才接名詞。
tip: because 接句子，because of 接名詞。
say: I can't go out because it is raining heavily.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Mom will make a cake for us _____ we help her clean the kitchen.
options: if
unless
although
because of

wrong.unless: unless 是『除非不』，會變成『除非我們幫忙，媽媽才不做蛋糕』，意思反了。
wrong.although: although 是轉折，這裡是條件，不是對立。
wrong.because of: because of 後面要接名詞，不能接 we help her。

why: 幫忙打掃是做蛋糕的條件，用 if 引導。
tip: 條件用 if，除非不用 unless。
say: Mom will make a cake for us if we help her clean the kitchen.
